ashok: heads up — saw a KV cache miss spike for a specific cohort in continuous batching this morning, correlates with kernel fallback to generic matmul. p95 decode latency jumped.
maria: which cohort? length or decode-rate?
ashok: decode-rate bucket ~ 45-60 tokens/sec, prompts ~ 1-3 tokens prefix. looks like small prompts with fast decoding causing weird queue composition.
jamie: can you paste the profiler snippet?
ashok: sure — stack dump + relevant lines:
```
queue_stats: {cohort_fast: 87 reqs, cohort_slow: 13 reqs}
batch_formation: prefer_fill=true, min_tokens=128, token_budget_per_batch=1024
kv_cache_hits: 0.32
kernel_choice: fallback_generic when avg_seq_len < 16 and kv_hit_rate < 0.5
```
lee: ops-bot reports a recent change to token_budget_target rolled out 2d ago. maybe drifted.
ops-bot: rollout token_budget_target=0.75 applied to region-us-east (canary->prod) @1729780000
maria: ah — token_budget_target drop would make batches try to pack more different prefixes -> reduces KV locality.
jamie: short-term: increase min_tokens to 64 and raise kv-prefetch threshold to 0.6 for the fast decode-rate cohort.
ashok: testing that locally now. also want to try moving the small-prefix fast-decode cohort into its own admission pool so kernels can be pinned.
maria: agree. update workload classifier: new feature: classify by `initial_prefix_tokens` and `decoded_tokens_per_sec` instead of only avg_len.
lee: what metrics to watch? p95/p99 latency, kv_hit_rate, kernel_switch_count, batch_fill_ratio.
jamie: add a perf regression alert for kernel_switch_count > 5/min — that previously maps to matmul fallback thrashing.
ashok: local run (30k reqs) with min_tokens=64 + kv_prefetch=0.6 shows kv_hit_rate up from 0.32 -> 0.61 and p95 decode down 22%.
maria: nice. rollout plan?
ashok: propose canary slice: 5% traffic for 2 hours, monitor alerts + trace sampling. revert if kernel_switch_count increases.
lee: also capture a few detailed traces to check if any downstream model variant mismatches occur.
jamie: will add a short experiment config, incl. classifier tweak + admission pool + token_budget_target bump for canary.
ops-bot: experiment created: exp-2024-07-23-queue-split-1729876543
maria: tagging infra for possible kernel-compile slack call if canary shows perf regression later: @lee @jamie :raised_hands:
ashok: thanks — I'll post the canary results here in ~2.5h. :thumbsup:
